hostNote: Darwin-only: the owner-operated verifier runs on macOS; this pin changes with Linux qualification.
linkerWrapperReason: rust-lld finds libLLVM.dylib through DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, which did not reach the linker when set through cargo's [env] in the local simulation; the wrapper sets it to <sysroot>/lib and execs <sysroot>/lib/rustlib/aarch64-apple-darwin/bin/rust-lld.

x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.reason: The target spec at 1.99.0 supports static-pie, so +crt-static with the default relocation model links an ET_DYN with DF_1_PIE and only relative relocations (confirmed by the local link).

aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.reason: The target spec at 1.99.0 has no static-pie default, so +crt-static links a static ET_EXEC without PT_DYNAMIC (confirmed by the local link). The executable image is therefore not randomised. Owner decision D3 (a) on design-review finding D3, relayed by the lane monitor on 2026-10-11: accept and record this shape, checked per target by the gate; forcing static-pie is left to a later packet.

commandLineTools.reason: Host dependency outside the profile's inventories (owner decision Q-HE2): cargo test links the aarch64-apple-darwin test binaries with the system linker, and HE-003B's ring C and assembly in the effect gate are compiled by this clang (owner decision Q-HE3B-3 (a)), so a missing path or a different clang --version first line or SDK version fails the gate.

cToolchain.reason: ring 0.17.14's C and pregenerated assembly for both musl targets are compiled by the Command Line Tools' clang and archived by its ar, set through the repository's .cargo/config.toml [env] (each forced); on x86_64 the flag line turns on ring's own no-libc-headers mode, which ring enables by itself on aarch64-musl. The darwin host build of ring keeps cc's default compiler (/usr/bin/cc, the same Command Line Tools through xcode-select). The gate derives the cargo config's [env] from this entry.
ownerDecisions: Q-HE3B-3 (a): Command Line Tools clang 14.0.3 plus ar through the repository's [env], with a failing version pin in toolchain.json and the gate (2026-10-14)
Q-HE3B-4 (a): the x86_64 no-libc-headers flag line (2026-10-14)
Q-HE3B-23 (a): [profile.release.build-override] strip = none; the darwin build keeps /usr/bin/cc, xcode-select and the first cc and ar on PATH checked (2026-10-14)
